full_judgment: 14. In the instant case, there is no community of interests of the accused per-sons in the transactions involved in the case so as to form part of one and the same transaction. The six loanees involving 6 independent loan cases taking place at different times stand out as six independent transactions and as such the accused persons could not legally be tried in a single trial. Neither Section-234 nor 239 of the Code provides the necessary succor to the prosecution to tide over this insurmountable legal difficulty in saving the proceedings. In the facts of the case, it must, therefore, be held that this case suffers from serious misjoinder of charges on the ground of misjoinder of causes of action. The trial, therefor, stands vitiated. Misjoinder of charge is a serious legal flaw which cannot be cured under the provisions of Section-537 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. I am, therefore constrained to hold that all the trials have been vitiated by misjoinder of charges, causing serious prejudice to the accused petitioner.
